[SWS_DM_01082] Security level check for sourceDataIdentifier
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04246, RS_Diag_04227
⌈
On reception of service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction ’de-
fineByIdentifier’ and if
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.
checkPerSourceId
is set to TRUE, the DM shall check if the sourceDataIdentifier
can be defined in the current security level according to [SWS_DM_00414]. If any
sourceDataIdentifier cannot be defined in the current security level, the DM shall re-
turn an NRC 0x33 (securityAccessDenied).
⌋
The DM does further session and security checks for all source
DIDs
if
Diagnos-
ticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.checkPerSourceId
is set to
TRUE when the
DDDID
is requested with UDS service 0x22 or 0x2A.
